planets.name: K2-62 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-62 with a 6.67-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-62 b was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around K2-62. Its orbit and size follow Howard et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
